parameters.query: SELECT d.id as deal_id, d.deal_value, d.stage, d.contact_id, c.source as first_touch_source, c.created_at as contact_created, d.created_at as deal_created, d.updated_at as deal_closed, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('type', la.activity_type, 'data', la.activity_data, 'at', la.created_at) ORDER BY la.created_at) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = d.contact_id) as touchpoints FROM deals d JOIN contacts c ON c.id = d.contact_id WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won' AND d.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
